goal: Build a low-cost MicroDuck for camera-guided beak pickup and reinforcement-learning experiments: perceive the target, align, grasp, lift, and assess success. Continue from the completed jaw training. Use one power source and consolidate purchases.
implementation_scope: Hardware architecture and build instructions; unassembled, visual software integration remains.

source.screen_v_basis: lowest accepted reading at the XT30 female before the robot is connected (guide step pd-tether)
source.cable: ROBOTIS 3-wire cable plugged into the SMPS2DXL, far servo plug cut off

cable_wires.pin2_vdd: +12 V, spliced to the tether red wire
cable_wires.pin1_gnd: GND, found with a meter, spliced to the tether black wire

source.origin: owned set from an OMX-AI kit allocated to the duck (order 2034348); not the arm set, not the reserved third kit

power.budget_basis: Calculation allocations at 5 V, not measured: 3 A sustained servo acceptance limit (guide step current, PROJECT-CONTEXT current_build.servo_power_path) or 5.4 A simulated 20 ms servo peaks (guide/extension-20261012-neck-audio/page/power_section.py), plus the 2 A non-motor reserve.

superseded_budget.source: r3 screen against the 20 V/3.25 A PD source (power-calculation.json); exceeds the 60 W 12 V supply

power.pi_branch_budget_scope: Unvalidated Zero-form-factor baseline; 1.5 A is not an accepted Pi 3 demand budget.

servo_order: Order 2034348 (ROBOTIS US, merchant-confirmed 2026-09-18): three OMX-AI kits. Two kits supply 16 XL330-M288-T and 4 OpenRB-150 for the 15-servo/1-controller build; the third kit stays intact for leader/follower experiments. Received: the user photo IMG_6972 (2026-10-13) shows XL330 servos with ID 3 and ID 15 stickers assembled on the robot and an OpenRB-150 on the bench. No tracking record is needed. One SMPS 12V 5A + SMPS2DXL + 3-wire cable set from a kit allocated to the duck is the robot wall supply (wall_power_change_20261013). Original servo/controller order fully refunded at merchant.

compute.pi: First-generation Raspberry Pi Zero W with soldered 40-pin header; preferred integration board
